05.index_row: | [`rules/05-performance.md`](rules/05-performance.md) | Latency/throughput/memory work: GC (gen/SOH/LOH, server vs workstation, DATAS on by default with Server GC), allocation reduction, `Span<T>`/`Memory<T>`/`ArrayPool`, `struct`/`record struct`, BenchmarkDotNet, async overhead, Native AOT / trimming, string handling |
